definitions.explanation: People who belong to the same group, share the same interests, or work together. Implies a sense of camaraderie and belonging.
Things that belong to the same category or type. Used for classification.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{信頼|しんらい}できる{仲間|なかま}だ。
{仲間|なかま}と{一緒|いっしょ}に{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went on a trip with my friends/companions.

examples.japanese: イルカは{鯨|くじら}の{仲間|なかま}です。
examples.english: Dolphins are in the whale family (same category as whales).
examples.notes: 〜の仲間 = belonging to the same category

notes:
USAGE: {仲間|なかま} implies a stronger bond than just 'friend'. It suggests people who share experiences, goals, or a sense of belonging together.

NUANCES:
・Implies solidarity and loyalty
・Often used for teammates, colleagues, or fellow group members
・Can indicate being 'one of us'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{仲間|なかま}に{入|い}る (to join a group)
・{仲間|なかま}に{入|い}れる (to include in the group)
・{仲間|なかま}{外|はず}れ (being left out, ostracism)
・{仲間|なかま}{意識|いしき} (sense of belonging)
・〜の{仲間|なかま} (belonging to the ~ category/group)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{友達|ともだち} - friend (general)
・{同僚|どうりょう} - colleague (work)
・{仲良|なかよ}し - close friend
・{同士|どうし} - fellow (suffix)
